question_text: Describe how you handle a coworker who behaves unprofessionally.
expected_answer: You address the issue privately set boundaries and escalate if behavior continues

question_text: Explain how you maintain professionalism during major workplace changes.
expected_answer: You stay adaptable communicate clearly and support team stability

question_text: Describe how you manage a situation where leadership gives unclear direction.
expected_answer: You ask clarifying questions align expectations and document next steps

question_text: Explain how you handle a coworker who spreads negativity.
expected_answer: You redirect conversations maintain positivity and avoid engaging in negative behavior

question_text: Describe how you maintain professionalism when dealing with difficult clients.
expected_answer: You stay calm listen carefully set expectations and remain respectful

question_text: Explain how you navigate ethical dilemmas professionally.
expected_answer: You follow policy consult leadership and choose actions that protect integrity

question_text: Describe how you manage team tension professionally.
expected_answer: You mediate discussions encourage respect and guide the team toward resolution

question_text: Explain how you maintain professionalism when under unfair criticism.
expected_answer: You stay composed respond with facts and escalate only when necessary

question_text: Describe how you handle confidential issues involving multiple departments.
expected_answer: You limit information share only what is required and follow strict policy

question_text: Explain how you uphold professionalism when representing the company externally.
expected_answer: You communicate clearly follow standards and maintain consistent professionalism
